question: By what percentage did Boeing's net income change from fiscal year 2021 to fiscal year 2022? Give the percentage rounded to one decimal place.
answer: Boeing's net income attributable to Boeing shareholders (net loss) changed by -17.4% from fiscal year 2021 to fiscal year 2022 (increasing in magnitude of loss from -$4,202 million in 2021 to -$4,935 million in 2022). Alternatively, total net loss (including noncontrolling interest) changed by -17.8% from -$4,290 million in 2021 to -$5,053 million in 2022.
rationale: The net loss attributable to Boeing shareholders increased from $4,202 million in FY2021 to $4,935 million in FY2022, representing a -17.4% change. If using total net loss including noncontrolling interest, it changed from $4,290 million to $5,053 million, representing a -17.8% change. Both figures are provided.
